title: 第一卷 第92章 老朽只想活命金阳上人第一卷 第91章 精品筑基丹老朽今年百二十岁难道等得起
slug: 凡人修仙从百岁老人娶妻开始
lines: 姬映雪想说的话明显噎住了。
而几位筑基也面露异色。
冲击筑基的年龄，理论上是越年轻越好。
史料记载，晋升筑基修士的最大年龄为一百四十三岁。
在南荒域修仙界的历史中，近几千年来，还没有一百三十岁以上筑基的先例。
至于散修，更是没有超过百岁。
基本八九十岁往上，就错过了巅峰，筑基成功率直线下滑。
望着满头白发的高龄老人，姬映雪沉默了数息，仍然开口道，
“诸位道友可知，我幼时一条贱命，体弱多病，若没有家弟挨家挨户乞讨，我早已死于饥寒交迫。
十岁那年，幼弟背着我在风雪中逃难，一路照料才侥幸到了县城，他也至此落下病根。
十三岁那年，我被十数乞丐堵上，若不是他舍命相护，险被玷污致死......”
姬映雪深吸一口气，孤傲的酥胸曲线，随着情绪起伏。
“诸位道友，试问尔等有这样一个弟弟，能忍心他中途离你而去？”
几人面面相觑。
林寻思索了数息，淡然道，
“姬仙子姐弟情深，在下有所耳闻，可惜，在下不仅没有这样一个弟弟，还是个孤儿。
我年少时曾与野狗抢过食，被邪修当过耗材.......
直到今日，磕磕绊绊一路修行，才有的筑基机会！
哪怕明知只有丁点概率，也想博一线生机！
老朽只想活命，难道这也有错？
姬仙子乃贵人，是要......”
说到最后，林寻整个人戚然，一股悲愤之情，在整个丹房浓稠的化不开。
对于姬映雪的故事，他是相当不屑。
开什么玩笑？
三两句话就想拿走他的精品筑基丹？
比惨是吧？
还能有他一个百岁老朽惨？
什么姐弟情深？
若这姬映雪不是上品灵根、金阳上人关门弟子。
有多少人能听完她的姐弟情深？

Ji Yingxue was obviously choked on what she wanted to say.
Several foundation builders also had strange expressions on their faces.
Theoretically, the younger the age when attacking foundation building, the better.
According to historical records, the maximum age for promotion to a Foundation Establishment Monk is one hundred and forty-three years old.
In the history of the Immortal Cultivation World in the Southern Wilderness Region, in the past few thousand years, there has been no precedent for anyone over 130 years old to build a foundation.
As for the casual cultivators, they are not more than a hundred years old.
Basically, from the age of eighty to ninety, the peak is missed, and the success rate of foundation building plummets.
Looking at the old man with white hair, Ji Yingxue was silent for a few breaths and then said,
"Fellow Taoists, you know, I had a poor life when I was young. I was weak and sick. If it weren't for my brothers who went from house to house begging for food, I would have died of hunger and cold.
When I was ten years old, my younger brother carried me on his back to escape in the wind and snow, and I had to take care of him all the way before he finally reached the county seat. This was where the root cause of his illness came to light.
When I was thirteen years old, I was blocked by dozens of beggars. If he hadn’t risked his life to protect me, I would have been defiled to death..."
Ji Yingxue took a deep breath, and the arrogant breast curves fluctuated with her emotions.
"Fellow Taoists, if you have such a younger brother, can you bear to have him leave you midway?"
Several people looked at each other.
Lin Xun thought for a few breaths and said calmly,
"I have heard about Fairy Ji's deep brother-sister love, but unfortunately, not only do I not have such a younger brother, I am also an orphan.
When I was young, I fought with wild dogs for food, and was used as consumables by evil cultivators...
Until today, after practicing hard and stumbling all the way, I only have the opportunity to build a foundation!
Even if I know there is only a slight chance, I still want to gain a chance of survival!
I just want to survive. Is this wrong?
Fairy Ji is a noble person, and she wants to..."
At the end of the sentence, Lin Xun was filled with sadness, a feeling of sadness and anger that could not be resolved in the entire alchemy room.
He was quite disdainful of Ji Yingxue's story.
Are you kidding me?
Want to take away his exquisite foundation-building pill in just a few words?
More miserable, right?
How could he be as miserable as a hundred-year-old man?
What kind of deep brother-sister relationship?
If this Ji Yingxue is not a high-grade spiritual root and a close disciple of Master Jin Yang.
How many people can listen to her love between brother and sister?
